description: An HTML demo page for CodeMirror showcasing the active line styling feature. It includes an embedded XML code sample and JavaScript code to initialize CodeMirror with specific options, including styleActiveLine and line numbering, as well as a toggle for the nonEmpty styleActiveLine option.

methods.name: toggleSelProp
methods.description: Toggles the nonEmpty styleActiveLine option for the CodeMirror editor and updates the button label accordingly.
